title: Wso2am: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection') vulnerability in Apache…
description: A medium severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-46718) affects the wso2am package due to unsafe reflection in Apache Calcite. This flaw involves the use of externally-controlled input to select classes or code, which can lead to limited confidentiality and integrity impacts. The issue is fixed in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
